TSLA.bear_case: Continued negative sentiment regarding global economic slowdown impacting consumer spending; further geopolitical tensions affecting supply chains or market access (e.g., China); any slight miss on upcoming delivery or earnings expectations; broader market correction impacting growth stocks; confirmed technical breakdown if actual indicators were available.
TSLA.bull_case: A strong, sudden influx of institutional buying driven by an unforeseen positive catalyst that overwhelms current cautious sentiment; a market-wide rotation into high-growth, innovation-driven stocks; a major short squeeze if short interest is high and a positive catalyst emerges.
